text:
emily-billing: FYI — Stripe dispute received for acct acme-xyz, amount $12,500, reason: "unauthorized charge". Dispute ID cb_1JkL... I think this ties to a promo campaign (PROMO2024) we ran. Can payments ops pull evidence? /cc @cs-team

raj-payments: link to stripe: https://dashboard.stripe.com/disputes/cb_1JkL... — need txn id, invoice, and any cardholder correspondence. Do we have API logs for the charge?

emily-billing: txn: ch_3MnoPq..., invoice: INV-2025-414, promo code applied: PROMO2024. Attached small log snippet:
```json
{"email":"user+promo@example.com","ip":"18.212.45.123","promo_applied":true,"order_amount":12500}
```
Customer's account email is user@example.com (no +promo). Not sure if that matters.

zoe-ops: risk flag = 3 on the account, auto-hold triggered. IP 18.212.45.123 is uncommon for this customer (last seen ap-southeast). I've put a soft block pending evidence. :eyes:

frank-manager: high-value chargebacks (>10k) should be escalated to legal/finance review. @raj-payments — can you bundle the evidence and send to disputes@redwood.ai? Also check lifetime activity for acct acme-xyz for promo abuse pattern.

raj-payments: On it. Will gather invoice, signed TOS (if any), API request headers, and cardholder email confirmation. Quick question: do we include the promo redemption history or redact parts?

cs-team: customer support has two emails from the cardholder claiming they didn't authorize the charge. They attached a screenshot that looks like a purchase receipt but no shipping address. Sending to @raj-payments now.

payments-bot: new_event: dispute_created cb_1JkL... | amount: 12500 | reason: unauthorized | status: needs_response

raj-payments: Evidence checklist I'm collecting:
- Invoice INV-2025-414 (done)
- API logs + IP + user agent (done)
- Promo redemption record with timestamp (done)
- CS correspondence (pending)
- Cardholder signature/receipt if available (pending)
I'll submit within 2 hours unless anyone needs extra items.

emily-billing: thanks — also confirm whether we should mark this as suspected promo-abuse for the cohort. If yes, we'll block promo after contest.

zoe-ops: agree to mark as suspected promo-abuse. I'll add a tag on the account and disable PROMO2024 for that tenant.

payments-bot: dispute_response_submitted cb_1JkL... | evidence: invoice,api_logs,promo_history,cs_correspondence

frank-manager: nice work. If dispute is lost, we'll consider reversing promo credit and pursuing recovery. Keep me posted.

emily-billing: closing loop — evidence submitted, CS notified cardholder, promo disabled for tenant. Will update if dispute outcome changes. :white_check_mark:
